entities.summary: William, a notable figure in the history of Canada, associated with British–French Rivalry and Conquest (1689–1748). Preceded by Colonial Wars in North America and Hudson's Bay Company. Their legacy influenced Battle Plains of Abraham 1759 and Treaty of Paris 1763.
